page_title: SAS 2-1 ATA | Sassuolo v Atalanta 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Referee Matteo Marchetti halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Raffaele Palladino, then shows him a yellow.
90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
90+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
90+3' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
90+2' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) jumped for a header from a cross inside the box, but the goalkeeper denies his effort as it bounces off his gloves and hits the post.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Ismael Kone is replaced by Josh Doig (Sassuolo).
88' 2 - 1 Davide Zappacosta feeds the ball through to Yunus Musah (Atalanta), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top right corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:1!
87' A quickly taken corner by Atalanta.
87' A wonderful first-time shot by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sees the ball bounce off the goalkeeper's gloves onto the post. Great goalkeeping.
85' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' The linesman raises his flag. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) is adjudged offside.
80' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
80' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
79' It looks like Alieu Fadera may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Fabio Grosso replaces him with Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo).
79' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is equal to it and makes an easy save.
76' Here is a change. Berat Djimsiti is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Isak Hien (Atalanta).
75' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Armand Lauriente can be given a rest.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nemanja Matic departs the field of play to be replaced by Luca Lipani (Sassuolo).
73' Fabio Grosso has decided to make a change. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) replaces Domenico Berardi.
73' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

72' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top right corner. Arijanet Muric shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
72' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
71' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

69' 2 - 0 Goal! Great link up play between Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) and Armand Lauriente gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top left corner. 2:0.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Yunus Musah (Atalanta) for Nicola Zalewski.
67' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
66' Atalanta fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
66' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked.
65' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
65' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
64' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends the corner into the box, but Arijanet Muric intercepts it and averts the threat.

63' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
61' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
60' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
58' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
58' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) picks up the rebound on the edge of the box and shoots. His effort, however, only finds the gloves of the opponent's goalkeeper.
57' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matteo Marchetti, who decides to show him a yellow.
55' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
52' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
51' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
51' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
49' The foul by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) was seen by Matteo Marchetti who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
47' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
46' Substitution. Lorenzo Bernasconi makes way for Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
46' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Raoul Bellanova will be replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
46' The substitution is prepared. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gianluca Scamacca.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' Domenico Berardi sends the free kick into the box. Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
45+2' Fabio Grosso is stunned as referee Matteo Marchetti shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
40' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot low towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
38' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).

35' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric pulls off an easy save.
34' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is first to a cross from Raoul Bellanova and thunders in a great header at goal from near the penalty spot that flies just over the bar.
30' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
29' The ball possession is 27:73.
27' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

27' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
26' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.

23' 1 - 0 Armand Lauriente produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the middle of the net. What a brilliant finish. 1:0.
23' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) prepares to take a corner kick.
23' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. The referee blows his whistle, Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
21' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
20' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
19' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
17' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
16' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
15' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
12' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
12' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!

11' What a miss! Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
10' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the top right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
10' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
9' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
9' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
2' Atalanta are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
Matteo Marchetti was nominated as the referee for this game.
